Name: Strange Machines Revisited
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[b]Official Compatibility Update for Stardew Valley 1.6 of [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8185][b]Strange Machines
[/b][/url]﻿With due [url=https://i.imgur.com/BputP4k.png]permissions [/url]from the original mod author, ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92060238]mrtaiyou[/url]﻿

[i]Kudos to [/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52191851]joey2324[/url] for helping me fix the Gift Taste SMAPI Error[/i]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Mod Features:[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*]Adds 7 New Machines: Alchemical Fuser, Brazier Furnace, Carbonizer, Fertilizer Maker, Gourmet Cheese Press, Gourmet Mayonnaise Machine, and Pan of Meals
[*]Adds 7 new artisan goods: BIG CHEESE as well as Big Goat Cheese, Large Mayonnaise, Large Void Mayonnaise, Large Duck Mayonnaise, Shiny Mayonnaise (Large Golden Mayonnaise), and Delight Mayonnaise (Ostrich Mayonnaise)
[*]Adds 3 new animal produce: Large Duck Egg, Large Void Egg, and Large Golden Egg (Finally! Ducks and other Chickens can now lay large eggs!)
Adds 4 new resources: Nickel Nugget, Nickel Bar (Smelted from Nickel Nugget), Blackstone, Black Brick (Smelted from Blackstone)[*]Adds 4 new stones that produces more stones when mined.
[*]Adds 1 new potion and 1 new artisan good: Liquid Luck and Glue
[*]Adds 1 new gem: Prismatic Fragment
[*]Adds Custom Gift Preferences for each new added items! Compatible with SVE and RSV.
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Machines Guide:[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Alchemical Fuser[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from Maru. She will send a mail at 6 Hearts, Winter, and Farming level 10.[/size]
[*][size=2]Egg Slimes upgrader (i.e. Green Slime to Blue Slime).[/size]
[*][size=2]Turns algae to slime.[/size]
[*][size=2]Turns wood to hardwood.[/size]
[*][size=2]Turns 10 Prismatic Fragment to Prismatic Shard.[/size]
[*][size=2]Turns 10 Starfruits to Liquid Luck (+10 Luck Potion).[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Brazier Furnace[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from Clint. He will send a mail at 5 Hearts.[/size]
[*][size=2]Twice as fast as your traditional furnace.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Carbonizer[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from mail. Year 2 at Spring on a Tuesday[/size]
[*][size=2]Turns any wood to coal (even paths and fences)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Fertilizer Maker[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from Leveling Up, Farming Level 7.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allows you to create various types of fertilizers. It requires 5 inputs and uses glue as fuel.[/size]
[/list][size=2]Immersive is Enabled
(Each recipe requires additional 10 Fiber | "OR" means you either get this or that, it is randomized)[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Fish for Basic OR Quality Fertilizer[/size]
[*][size=2]Syrup (Oak, Pine, Maple) for Speed-Gro OR Deluxe Speed-Gro[/size]
[*][size=2]Clay for Basic, Quality, OR Deluxe Retaining Soil[/size]
[*][size=2]Vegetable for Deluxe Fertilizer[/size]
[size=2](Qi Walnut Room must be unlocked first)[/size][*][size=2]Fruit for Hyper Speed-Gro[/size]
[size=2](Qi Walnut Room must be unlocked first)[/size][/list][size=2]Immersive is Disabled
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Vanilla Recipe, takes the most valuable ingredient as the input.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Gourmet Cheese Press[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from Marnie. She will send a mail at 10 Hearts, Spring, and Year 2[/size]
[*][size=2]Twice as fast as your traditional cheese maker (Compatible with Visit Mt Vapius)[/size]
[*][size=2]The only way to make BIG CHEESE and Big Goat Cheese.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extra Large Milks from the Mt Vapius Mod will produce 2 BIG CHEESES when using this machine.[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=3]Gourmet Mayonnaise Machine[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Obtained from Marnie. She will send a mail at 5 Hearts, Spring, and Year 2[/size]
[*][size=2]Twice as fast as your traditional cheese maker (Compatible with Visit Mt Vapius)[/size]
[*][size=2]The only way to make Large Mayonnaise, Large Void Mayonnaise, Large Duck Mayonnaise, Shiny Mayonnaise (Large Golden Mayonnaise), and Delight Mayonnaise (Ostrich Mayonnaise)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Pan of Meals[/b][/size][list]
[*]Obtained from Gus at 10 Hearts. Watch his event at the Saloon.
[*]Can only be crafted once.
[*]Produces a random food item each day.
[/list]
Other noteworthy information:
[list]
[*]Glue: Made from putting syrups (maple syrup, pine tar, or oak resin) to a keg (you need at least 3).
If you have Extra Machine Config installed, you need to put 10 sap plus 1 maple syrup, 1 pine tar, and 1 oak resin. [*]Nickel Nugget: Spawns at Iron Level. Can also spawn at Skull Caverns
[*]Blackstone: Spawns at Gold Level. Can also spawn at Skull Caverns
[*]Wood Piece: Can only obtained from Gus in his 10 hearts. WHEN YOU GET IT, DO NOT SELL IT.
[*]Rusty Pan: Can only obtained from Gus in his 10 hearts. WHEN YOU GET IT, DO NOT SELL IT.
[/list]
[color=#d9ead3][b]Compatible with (On a Technical Level):[/b]
[list]
[*]6480's Blue Chickens
[*]Arrbyte's Canaries﻿
[*]Arrbyte's Lovebirds﻿﻿
[*]Arrbyte's Zebrafinches﻿
[*]Cornucopia - Artisan Goods
[*]Lumisteria's Visit to Mount Vapius
[*]Mizu's Quails
[*]Mizu's Turkeys
[*]LordDracon's (BasiliskL) Eggs Mayo and Cheese Expansion
[*]AngellTear's (nadyeszti) Void Ducks
[/list][/color]
[color=#fff2cc][b]Will provide compatibility (in the future) with:[/b]
[/color][list]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Trent's New Animals[/color]
[/list]
